evidence.intree_statement: Definition crude_monadicity : EquivalenceOfCategories (EM_Comparison A) := {| quasi_inverse := Crude_Inverse ; equivalence_counit := crude_equivalence_counit ; equivalence_unit := crude_equivalence_unit |}.  [Context (A : F ⊣ U); (RC : HasReflexiveCoequalizers C); (pres : PreservesReflexiveCoequalizers U); (refl : ReflectsIsos U)]

Definition PreservesReflexiveCoequalizers {C D : Category} (U : C ⟶ D) : Type := ∀ (x y : C) (f g : x ~{C}~> y), ReflexivePair f g → ∀ (q : C) (e : y ~{C}~> q), IsCoequalizer f g q e → IsCoequalizer (fmap[U] f) (fmap[U] g) (U q) (fmap[U] e).
Definition Monadic {C D : Category} (U : C ⟶ D) : Type := ∃ (F : D ⟶ C) (A : F ⊣ U), EquivalenceOfCategories (EM_Comparison A).

statement_record.book: Exercise VI.7.7 (Crude Tripleability Theorem, Barr-Beck): if G:A→X is CTT (per Def VI.7.3: G has a left adjoint; A has coequalizers of all pairs in C_G = pairs whose G-image has a coequalizer in X; and G both preserves and reflects coequalizers of all pairs in C_G), then the comparison functor K:A→X^T is an equivalence of categories.
statement_record.intree: crude_monadicity : EquivalenceOfCategories (EM_Comparison A), given F ⊣ U, HasReflexiveCoequalizers C, U preserves reflexive coequalizers (elementary form), and U reflects isomorphisms.
statement_record.strength_comparison: same conclusion (the comparison K is an equivalence of categories); intree-different hypothesis packaging: the in-tree theorem is the standard Barr-Wells reflexive-coequalizer form (C has reflexive coequalizers + U preserves them + U conservative), whereas MacLane's Def VI.7.3 CTT is packaged over the class C_G of all pairs whose image has a coequalizer with 'G preserves and reflects coequalizers of C_G pairs'. These are recognized equal-strength standard formulations of 'crude tripleability' (MacLane's Def VI.7.3 explicitly defers to 'more authoritative CTT/VTT definitions in Barr-Wells 1985', which is the reflexive form proved here), but they are not literally the same hypothesis set.

gap: MacLane's own Def VI.7.3 CTT hypotheses (the class C_G of all pairs whose G-image has a coequalizer; the requirement that G both preserve AND reflect coequalizers of C_G pairs; that A have coequalizers of C_G pairs) are NOT the ones formalized. The in-tree crude_monadicity instead assumes reflexive coequalizers in C, U-preservation of them, and U conservative (reflects isos). The conclusion (K an equivalence) matches exactly, and the two hypothesis sets are the standard equivalent 'crude' criteria, but MacLane's C_G-class preserve+reflect packaging is not literally reproduced.

statement_record.book: Theorem VI.8.1: for a set Omega of operators and a set E of identities, with G the forgetful functor from the category <Omega,E>-Alg of small algebras to Set and T the induced monad on Set, the comparison functor K : <Omega,E>-Alg → Set^T is an ISOMORPHISM of categories (proved via Beck's theorem: G creates coequalizers of pairs whose underlying maps have an absolute coequalizer e, transporting each n-ary operation along e^n).
statement_record.intree: Lawvere_crude_monadicity : the comparison Models T Sets → (Eilenberg-Moore of the induced monad) is an EQUIVALENCE of categories, given a Lawvere theory T, a left adjoint L ⊣ ev1 T supplied as DATA, and the crude hypotheses (reflexive coequalizers, ev1-preservation, ev1-conservativity) supplied as DATA.
statement_record.strength_comparison: intree-weaker on three axes: (1) strength — the in-tree result concludes an EQUIVALENCE, not the isomorphism of categories MacLane proves; (2) hypothesis-scoped — the underlying free/forgetful adjunction (L ⊣ ev1 T) and all crude-monadicity hypotheses are taken as given DATA, none discharged for the algebraic case, whereas MacLane proves the theorem outright by Beck's criterion; (3) presentation — the in-tree object is Models T Sets (Cartesian+Terminal-preserving functors out of a Lawvere theory, over setoids Sets), not the syntactic <Omega,E>-Alg signature-with-identities category, and the separately-existing Instance/Comp.v variety category is entirely disconnected from the monad/EM machinery.

gap: No in-tree theorem states that the forgetful functor of a variety (equational category) to Set is monadic with the comparison an ISOMORPHISM.
